options.name: DISABLE_MALI_COMPAT
options.description: Loader switch that forces the compat layer off even when ENABLE_MALI_COMPAT is set.

options.name: DISABLE_MALI_WSI
options.description: Loader switch that forces the WSI layer off.

options.name: ENABLE_MALI_COMPAT
options.description: Loads the compat layer (implicit Vulkan layer); DroidDeck sets it for bridge games. Nothing below has an effect without it.

options.name: ENABLE_MALI_WSI
options.description: Loads the Arm window-system-integration layer (Wayland/X11 swapchains on the vendor driver). Nothing MALI_WSI_* has an effect without it.

options.name: MALI_BRIDGE_DEBUG
options.description: ICD shim logs to stderr.

options.name: MALI_BRIDGE_HAL
options.description: Load another HAL instead of the phone vendor Vulkan driver.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_ASYNC_PSO
options.description: Compile graphics pipelines on worker threads and wait at most this many ms; a slower one returns a stand-in whose draws are dropped until ready (pop-in instead of a stall). 0 = off.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_ASYNC_THREADS
options.description: Worker threads for ASYNC_PSO.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_BC_AFRC
options.description: BC textures keep fixed-rate (AFRC) compressed shadow images; 0 = uncompressed shadows (needs much more GPU memory).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_BUDGET_LOG_S
options.description: Interval of the budget log line (printed only with GPU_TIME or DEBUG).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_BUDGET_MB
options.description: VK_EXT_memory_budget with live accounting, heapBudget capped at this size in MiB (0 = default report: min(heap, 6 GiB)).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM
options.description: Cover-trim: limits the listed screen-space AO compute dispatches and the composite draw to the screen cells near the weapon camera geometry (The Long Dark). Needs the hash lists below.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_ARM
options.description: <mrt>:<maxdraws>: arm after a pass with at least that many colour targets and at most that many draws.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_CS
options.description: Compute shader hashes to trim, optional extra dilation in px.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_FS
options.description: Composite fragment shader hashes to trim.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_GRID
options.description: <nx>x<ny> cell grid (nx*ny <= 64).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_K
options.description: Extra dilation in dispatch groups.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_MARGIN
options.description: Margin in px around the covered tiles.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_MAXOPS
options.description: Trimmed operations per arming.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_TOGGLE
options.description: Trim only while this file exists (A/B inside one launch).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DEBUG
options.description: Compat layer logging.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DEPTH_EQUAL
options.description: Replaces the EQUAL depth compare op of no-write graphics pipelines (HZD G-buffer test).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DEPTH_NOCOMP
options.description: Create sampled depth/stencil images uncompressed.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_CAPTURE
options.description: Captures resolved descriptor bindings of these compute shaders to a TSV (costs time and disk).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_CAPTURE_FILE
options.description: Output of DESC_CAPTURE.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_CAPTURE_MB
options.description: Size cap in MiB of DESC_CAPTURE.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_POOL_PAD
options.description: Adds every core descriptor type a pool does not list, n x maxSets.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_POOL_SCALE
options.description: Multiplies maxSets and every descriptor count of each descriptor pool (the vendor driver enforces pool counts); falls back to the app's sizes if the scaled pool fails.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DEVICE_ID
options.description: PCI device ID reported together with VENDOR_ID.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DEVICE_NAME
options.description: Device name reported together with VENDOR_ID.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DMABUF_EXPORT
options.description: Emulates dma-buf export: exportable linear images get dma-heap memory imported into the driver (gamescope nested backend).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DMABUF_HEAP
options.description: The dma-heap used by DMABUF_EXPORT.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DMABUF_PEEK
options.description: Every 5 s how much of each exported buffer is non-zero.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DRM_NODE
options.description: Reports VK_EXT_physical_device_drm with this character device (e.g. /dev/mali0) as primary and render node (gamescope).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DSL_STAGE_RETRY
options.description: Retries a failed descriptor set layout with stageFlags & 0x3f3f.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_DUMP_HASH
options.description: Writes shaders with these hashes to /root/mali-spv-<hash>.spv.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FAIL_LOG
options.description: Logs failing shader modules, pipelines, descriptor layouts/pools/sets to stderr (2 = also the first successful calls).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FAKE_OCCLUSION
options.description: Every occlusion query reads as visible.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FB_MASK
options.description: Which classes of full barriers the layer adds (0x0d6 = ALL_COMMANDS src/dst stages and memory access masks on the app barriers, plus full barriers before passes, after dispatches and after copies; 0 = off). Cures the Witcher 3 terrain flashes and the Control shadow flicker.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FORCE_COHERENT
options.description: Allocations from the non-coherent cached host memory type go to the coherent one of the same heap.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FORCE_COMP
options.description: Give attachments without STORAGE their compression back when vkd3d-proton asks for none.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FP16_HIDE_PROCS
options.description: Hides shaderFloat16/shaderInt16 from these processes.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FRAGDEPTH_FIX
options.description: Removes gl_FragDepth writes in pipelines without a depth/stencil attachment (on by default; 0 = off).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_FULL_BARRIERS
options.description: Diagnosis: ALL_COMMANDS barriers on every app barrier (1) or around every pass/copy/dispatch (2).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_GPU_TIME
options.description: GPU profiler: top passes/dispatches every 5 s, compile times, STUCK lines.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_GS_HIDE_PROCS
options.description: Hides geometryShader from these processes (Xwayland under gamescope).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_GT_SPLIT_SKIP
options.description: With GPU_TIME: no timestamps around suspending/resuming parts (they are invalid there).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_GT_TRACE
options.description: With GPU_TIME: log every pass that uses this shader hash (all = every pass).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_MEMLOG
options.description: Memory event log /root/mali-memlog-<comm>.tsv (2 = without the opaque-address query).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_MEMLOG_MB
options.description: Size cap in MiB of the memory log per process.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_NOATT_AREA
options.description: Clamps DXVK's attachment-less passes (16384x16384, 256 layers) to this area and one layer; they hung the GPU.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_NO_SUSPEND_RESUME
options.description: Turns vkd3d-proton's suspended/resumed render passes into plain passes (fixes blocky sky, needed by Control).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_PASSTHRU
options.description: A/B switch: every call except create/destroy goes straight to the driver (only CreateDevice feature masking stays).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_PIPELINE_CACHE
options.description: Persistent pipeline cache per process (1: /root/.cache/mali-compat/<process>.pcache, fine with DXVK, wrong pipelines with vkd3d-proton) or 2: in memory only, one cache per compile thread.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_PIPELINE_CACHE_THREADS
options.description: Threads that use the pipeline cache; dxvk-cs for DXVK games.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_COMPRESS
options.description: Render-target compression; learned UAV targets are kept in /root/mali-rt-keep-<process>.txt.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_PIPELINE
options.description: Requests VK_KHR_ray_tracing_pipeline emulation (DXR). Not implemented in this build: logs one line and changes nothing (see "rt_pipeline" above).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SKIP_HASH
options.description: With GPU_TIME: drop the draws of pipelines with this shader.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SPV_DONTUNROLL
options.description: Marks every shader loop DontUnroll (against slow compiles).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SPV_FIX
options.description: Two SPIR-V rewrites against vendor-compiler aborts (u32->u64->float conversions, uniform BroadcastFirst).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_STATS
options.description: Counters every 5 s (every = on every BC upload).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SUBMIT_IDLE
options.description: Diagnosis: after every queue submit wait for the GPU to go idle (1 = cap 250 ms, else the cap in ms).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SUSRES_BARRIER
options.description: With NO_SUSPEND_RESUME: one memory barrier before each converted resuming part. Did not fix the Control flicker.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SYNC_CTL
options.description: Path of a control file ("fb=2 si=1 k4=0", "fbm=0x0d6") read every 250 ms to change the sync-diagnosis mode within one launch.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SYNC_LOG
options.description: Log file of the sync diagnosis.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_SYNC_REPORT_S
options.description: Interval in seconds of the sync-diagnosis counter line.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_VENDOR_ID
options.description: Reports another PCI vendor ID (driverID stays Arm); 10de also gives the device name "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080" unless DEVICE_ID/NAME are set. 5143 makes vkd3d-proton use push descriptors for root CBVs.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_VS_STORES
options.description: Log-only vertex-stage store scan (on anyway with GPU_TIME).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_WAIT_CALLERS
options.description: With GPU_TIME: per-caller fence-wait statistics in each report.

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_WLS_CLAMP
options.description: Clamps every dynamic index into a workgroup-storage array so out-of-range indices stay inside it (stops GPU MMU faults of DXVK TGSM shaders).

options.name: MALI_COMPAT_XFB_VS
options.description: D3D11 stream output: a passthrough capture geometry shader is dropped and the vertex shader captures (Unity GPU skinning: Yooka-Laylee 80-90 FPS against 19-20).

options.name: MALI_WSI_ASYNC_PRESENT
options.description: WSI layer: presentation thread also for swapchains without explicit sync; vkQueuePresentKHR returns after the fence submit (Control +8 % FPS). Set to 0 or 1 it logs one line per swapchain.

options.name: MALI_WSI_FPS
options.description: WSI layer counts presents and appends "HH:MM:SS fps N.N" every 5 s to /root/mali-wsi-fps.txt (frame rate for games without a HUD).

options.name: MALI_WSI_NO_10BIT
options.description: Hides the 10-bit surface formats (test switch).

options.name: MALI_WSI_PACE
options.description: Times acquire/flip, writes the pace file.

options.name: MALI_WSI_PACE_FILE
options.description: Output file of MALI_WSI_PACE.

options.name: MALI_WSI_PACE_HZ
options.description: Pace rate in Hz for MALI_WSI_PACE (period = 1000/Hz ms).

options.name: MALI_WSI_PROBE_PIXELS
options.description: Probes the presented pixels (diagnosis).
